# Test Fixtures Manifest

This manifest documents the origin, licence, checksum, and purpose of all test fixtures in `tests/fixtures/`.
Total directory size: ~3.0 MB (limit <= 8.0 MB).

## 1. Procedural Fixtures (Generated by `fixturegen`)
Generated deterministically via `PYTHONPATH=research/R0-1 uv run python -m fixturegen all --seed 1234`.

| File | Origin | Licence | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `equations.jsonl` | Handcrafted by PenPress team (2026-10-13) | MIT / CC0 | 125 LaTeX equations across arithmetic, fractions, calculus, matrices, physics, chemistry, units with difficulty 1-3. |
| `stroke_recovery_sample.png` | Hershey Vector Font rasterisation | Public Domain (Hershey) | Ground truth stroke recovery image with ink bleed simulation. |
| `stroke_recovery_sample.json` | PenPress primitives export | MIT | Vector polyline ground truth coordinates for `stroke_recovery_sample.png`. |
| `sample_sheet_caveat.png` | Generated using Google Font Caveat | SIL OFL 1.1 | Synthetic handwriting sample sheet with cell jitter, paper grain, and rotation. |
| `sample_sheet_caveat.json` | Generated ground truth | MIT | Cell bounding boxes and character labels for Caveat sample sheet. |
| `sample_sheet_kalam.png` | Generated using Google Font Kalam | SIL OFL 1.1 | Synthetic handwriting sample sheet with Kalam font. |
| `sample_sheet_kalam.json` | Generated ground truth | MIT | Cell annotations for Kalam sample sheet. |
| `sample_sheet_indieflower.png` | Generated using Google Font Indie Flower | SIL OFL 1.1 | Synthetic handwriting sample sheet with Indie Flower font. |
| `sample_sheet_indieflower.json` | Generated ground truth | MIT | Cell annotations for Indie Flower sample sheet. |
| `sample_sheet_gochihand.png` | Generated using Google Font Gochi Hand | SIL OFL 1.1 | Synthetic handwriting sample sheet with Gochi Hand font. |
| `sample_sheet_gochihand.json` | Generated ground truth | MIT | Cell annotations for Gochi Hand sample sheet. |
| `bed_scene_topdown_bright.png` | Procedural Ender 3 Pro Bed Render | MIT | 0 deg top-down camera view, bright lighting preset, bed + A5 paper corners. |
| `bed_scene_topdown_bright.json` | Procedural ground truth | MIT | Paper corners in bed mm and image px, homography matrix, clip polygons. |
| `bed_scene_oblique_dim.png` | Procedural Ender 3 Pro Bed Render | MIT | 25 deg oblique angle, dim lighting preset, tilted bed perspective. |
| `bed_scene_oblique_dim.json` | Procedural ground truth | MIT | Homography and 3D bed coordinates for oblique dim scene. |
| `bed_scene_oblique_harsh.png` | Procedural Ender 3 Pro Bed Render | MIT | 35 deg oblique angle, harsh lighting with specular reflection. |
| `bed_scene_oblique_harsh.json` | Procedural ground truth | MIT | Ground truth parameters for harsh oblique scene. |
| `negative_blank_page.png` | Generated blank sheet | MIT | Negative fixture: zero ink. |
| `negative_missing_corner.png` | Generated paper polygon | MIT | Negative fixture: sheet with top-right corner torn off. |
| `negative_paper_out_of_frame.png` | Generated translated sheet | MIT | Negative fixture: paper shifted partially off camera frame. |
| `negative_glare_corner.png` | Generated specular glare | MIT | Negative fixture: saturated white glare blob obscuring corner. |
| `p1_5_text_120words.txt` | Handcrafted 121-word academic paragraph | MIT | Ground truth paragraph for end-to-end OCR CER verification. |
